title: filesTouched should only reflect task-modified files, not all files in a bundled PR
body: The context.json filesTouched field listed all 7 changed files in the PR, not just the files this task actually modified (AGENTS.md). Future task artifacts should only enumerate files the task itself touched, not the full PR diff.
rationale: Accurate filesTouched is needed for audit trails and task-memory-extractor processing.
